the performance of a collective irrigation system depends on the interaction of the social and technical determinants of the system, the quality of the water, and the quality of the land, as well as the management and the technical practices.

the performance of a collective irrigation system and of date palm orchards is determined by the interaction of several factors, including: (i) technical constraints related to water management and to salinity; (ii) socio-economic and institutional constraints related to the functioning of the irrigation system and to farmers' strategies; (iii) the farmers' perception of the constraints and the way they deal with them.
